_comment: Source of truth for the cli_commands[] portion of .vrooli/endpoints.json. Hand-maintained because the CLI is a separate Go module from the API; cross-module codegen would force one to import the other. Each entry mirrors a real subcommand registered in cli/domains/<dom>/register.go (or cli-core's StandardScenarioApp built-ins). Codegen verifies every cli_mapping.command in endpoints[] has a matching name here.

cli_commands.name: status
cli_commands.description: Check API and dependency health (auto-provided by cli-core's StandardScenarioApp)

cli_commands.name: providers register
cli_commands.description: Register (upsert) a provider descriptor (--descriptor JSON or @file)

cli_commands.name: query
cli_commands.description: Federated search across registered providers (explicit --type/--all/--group; classifier lands Phase 5)

cli_commands.name: federation
cli_commands.description: Federation status: per-provider reachability + classifier/reranker availability (RoutingService.Status)

cli_commands.name: insights
cli_commands.description: Federation telemetry insights: zero-result rate, p50/p95 latency, per-provider utilization (--window <days>)

cli_commands.name: evals register
cli_commands.description: Register (upsert) a provider-owned eval suite (--suite JSON or @file)

cli_commands.name: evals show
cli_commands.description: Show one eval suite by suite_id

cli_commands.name: evals run
cli_commands.description: Run an eval suite against its provider and store a tagged run (--tag, --limit)

cli_commands.name: evals validate
cli_commands.description: Re-probe reviewed positive labels and classify expect_ids as live, hard, stale, or inconclusive

cli_commands.name: evals runs
cli_commands.description: List a suite's run history, newest first (--tag, --limit filters)

cli_commands.name: evals show-run
cli_commands.description: Show one immutable eval run by run_id

cli_commands.name: evals compare
cli_commands.description: Compare two eval runs (per-case outcome + score delta)

cli_commands.name: evals sweep
cli_commands.description: Overfit-safe two-tier tuning sweep; --apply writes back a significant, validated winner

cli_commands.name: evals generate
cli_commands.description: Grow a suite's corpus by sampling + inverting the provider's index (+ hard negatives); --apply appends the deduped proposals

cli_commands.name: evals promote
cli_commands.description: Promote reviewed candidate cases into the acceptance recall denominator
